sql-service.name: anl.obscriptManagement.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT SCRIPT_ID, CONCEPT_ID, SCRIPT_NAME, CONCEPT_NAME, LIMIT_SCORE, USE_YN, st.REG_ID, (SELECT USER_NAME FROM cs_usermaster WHERE USER_ID = st.REG_ID) REG_NM, REG_DATE, st.CHG_ID, (CASE CHG_ID WHEN NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT USER_NAME FROM cs_usermaster WHERE USER_ID = st.CHG_ID) END) CHG_NM, CHG_DATE FROM vs_regu_script st WHERE 1=1 ?concept_nm ?script_nm ORDER BY SCRIPT_ID DESC, CONCEPT_ID DESC

sql-service.name: anl.obscriptManagement.item.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT sc.SCRIPT_ID, sc.CONCEPT_ID, sc.SCRIPT_NAME, sc.CONCEPT_NAME, st.KEYWORD, sc.USE_YN, sc.REG_ID, (SELECT USER_NAME FROM cs_usermaster WHERE USER_ID = sc.REG_ID) REG_NM, sc.REG_DATE, st.CHG_ID, (CASE st.CHG_ID WHEN NULL THEN NULL ELSE (SELECT USER_NAME FROM cs_usermaster WHERE USER_ID = st.CHG_ID) END) CHG_NM, sc.CHG_DATE, st.SENT_ID, st.SENTENCE FROM vs_regu_script sc, vs_regu_sent st WHERE sc.SCRIPT_ID = st.SCRIPT_ID AND sc.CONCEPT_ID = st.CONCEPT_ID AND sc.SCRIPT_ID = ?SCRIPT_ID AND st.CONCEPT_ID = ?CONCEPT_ID ORDER BY st.sent_id

sql-service.name: anl.obscriptManagement.item.del
sql-service.query: DELETE FROM vs_regu_script WHERE SCRIPT_ID = ?SCRIPT_ID AND CONCEPT_ID = ?CONCEPT_ID

sql-service.name: anl.obscriptManagement.sent.del
sql-service.query: DELETE FROM vs_regu_sent WHERE SCRIPT_ID = ?SCRIPT_ID AND CONCEPT_ID = ?CONCEPT_ID

sql-service.name: anl.obscriptManagement.sent.ins
sql-service.query: INSERT INTO vs_regu_sent(SCRIPT_ID ,SENT_ID ,CONCEPT_ID ,SENTENCE ,KEYWORD ,REG_ID ,REG_DATE) VALUES (?SCRIPT_ID ,(NEXT VALUE FOR dbo.seq_sent_id) , ?CONCEPT_ID ,?SENTENCE ,?KEYWORD ,?REG_ID ,format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') )

sql-service.name: anl.obscriptManagement.sent.upt
sql-service.query: IF EXISTS( SELECT * FROM vs_regu_sent WHERE SCRIPT_ID = ?SCRIPT_ID AND CONCEPT_ID = ?CONCEPT_ID AND SENT_ID = ?SENT_ID ) UPDATE vs_regu_sent SET SENTENCE = ?SENTENCE, KEYWORD = ?KEYWORD, CHG_ID = ?CHG_ID, CHG_DATE = format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') WHERE SCRIPT_ID = ?SCRIPT_ID AND CONCEPT_ID = ?CONCEPT_ID AND SENT_ID = ?SENT_ID ELSE INSERT INTO vs_regu_sent(SCRIPT_ID ,SENT_ID ,CONCEPT_ID ,SENTENCE ,KEYWORD ,REG_ID ,REG_DATE) VALUES (?SCRIPT_ID ,(NEXT VALUE FOR dbo.seq_sent_id) , ?CONCEPT_ID ,?SENTENCE ,?KEYWORD ,?REG_ID ,format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') )

sql-service.name: anl.obscriptManagement.item.upt
sql-service.query: UPDATE vs_regu_script SET CONCEPT_NAME = ?CONCEPT_NAME ,SCRIPT_NAME = ?SCRIPT_NAME ,CHG_ID = ?CHG_ID ,CHG_DATE = format(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMddHHmmss') WHERE SCRIPT_ID = ?SCRIPT_ID AND CONCEPT_ID = ?CONCEPT_ID

sql-service.name: anl.obscriptManagement.seq.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT NEXT VALUE FOR seq_concept_id AS SEQ_VAL

sql-service.name: anl.getGradeSumRes.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT GRADE, COUNT(GRADE) AS COUNT FROM vs_grade_sum WHERE 1=1 AND SUBSTRING(START_TIME,0,9) = ?start_time GROUP BY GRADE ORDER BY GRADE

sql-service.name: anl.gradeManagement.history.sel
sql-service.query: select REG_DATE ,u.USER_NAME ,GRADE ,BAN_SCORE ,CASE BAN_STD WHEN 'M' THEN '이상' WHEN 'E' THEN '초과' WHEN 'L' THEN '이하' WHEN 'U' THEN '미만' END BAN_STD ,SCRIPT_SCORE , CASE SCRIPT_STD WHEN 'M' THEN '이상' WHEN 'E' THEN '초과' WHEN 'L' THEN '이하' WHEN 'U' THEN '미만' END SCRIPT_STD ,BEF_SCORE , CASE BEF_STD WHEN 'M' THEN '이상' WHEN 'E' THEN '초과' WHEN 'L' THEN '이하' WHEN 'U' THEN '미만' END BEF_STD ,COND1 , CASE COND1_STD WHEN 'M' THEN '이상' WHEN 'E' THEN '초과' WHEN 'L' THEN '이하' WHEN 'U' THEN '미만' END COND1_STD ,COND2 , CASE COND2_STD WHEN 'M' THEN '이상' WHEN 'E' THEN '초과' WHEN 'L' THEN '이하' WHEN 'U' THEN '미만' END COND2_STD ,COND3 , CASE COND3_STD WHEN 'M' THEN '이상' WHEN 'E' THEN '초과' WHEN 'L' THEN '이하' WHEN 'U' THEN '미만' END COND3_STD from ms_grade_version g, ms_usermaster u where reg_id = user_id

sql-service.name: anl.getScriptScoreSpread.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 0 AND SCORE <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_10 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 10 AND SCORE <= 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_20 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 20 AND SCORE <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_30 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 30 AND SCORE <= 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_40 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 40 AND SCORE <= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_50 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 50 AND SCORE <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_60 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 60 AND SCORE <= 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_70 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 70 AND SCORE <= 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_80 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 80 AND SCORE <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_90 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 90 AND SCORE <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_100 FROM vs_regu_sum

sql-service.name: anl.getBanScoreSpread.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 0 AND SCORE <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_10 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 10 AND SCORE <= 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_20 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 20 AND SCORE <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_30 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 30 AND SCORE <= 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_40 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 40 AND SCORE <= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_50 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 50 AND SCORE <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_60 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 60 AND SCORE <= 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_70 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 70 AND SCORE <= 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_80 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 80 AND SCORE <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_90 ,sum(CASE WHEN SCORE > 90 AND SCORE <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) CNT_100 FROM vs_ban_sum
